_doc: Fact bank for gimme-job. The writer may only reword these; fact-checker blocks anything else. Add facts with a source + proof.

facts.claim: AI Engineer with 2 years building production agentic AI, RAG, and LLM gateway systems on Azure, GCP, and AWS. Startup-trained to own systems from architecture to production; now designs reusable agent platforms built around cost, safety, and team adoption.

Built an orchestrator-subagent SDLC system turning Jira epics into research, plans, code, and Playwright tests over GitHub, Bitbucket, Atlassian, and Microsoft MCP; tiered model routing cut token cost 48% at task success.

Generalized it into a team shared agentic harness and plugin marketplace with custom orchestration, lazy tool loading, declarative sandbox policies, and eval-driven tuning, porting legacy code to a UI/UX-driven web client.

Built rolling LLM conversation compaction for MAF agents in C#/.NET, replacing 100-message truncation with summarization triggered past 120K tokens, bounding context while retaining history in unbounded sessions.

Hardened Kong AI Gateway as the control layer for LLM traffic with AI Prompt Guard allow/deny policies, content-safety guardrails, and token-based rate limiting, plus custom Lua plugins for per-user token metrics.

Debugged a failing GCP Cloud SQL backup pipeline (0/21 exports) across GitHub Actions CI/CD, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and IAM; added alerting cutting failure detection from 30 min to ~15s, fixed in Terraform.

Built zero-downtime credential rotation for a multi-tenant Kong Konnect gateway with Azure Event Grid, HashiCorp Vault, and OIDC auth using dual-write grace periods, keeping tenant traffic live during rollovers.

Engineered a self-hosted MCP server and Python/pytest framework that validates OAuth2 authorization across 5 integration scenarios in CI/CD, replacing a paid vendor with deterministic, reproducible tests.

Decommissioned a retired data source from 3 RAG agents on Azure AI Search and GCP Vertex AI, removing ETL loaders and Helm/ArgoCD Kubernetes templates, with regression tests protecting retrieval quality.

Owned the end-to-end architecture of Slideoo's AI document-generation backend with agent orchestration, LLM tool calling, & reasoning on Azure and AWS, scaling to 10x traffic & 2,000+ users while cutting cloud spend 35%.

Rebuilt the multimodal LLM pipeline for PowerPoint generation by profiling bottlenecks and re-engineering prompt orchestration, cutting generation latency 77% (3+ min to 40s) & directly lifting subscription growth 43%.

Benchmarked competing LLM candidates for production by analyzing evaluation results and datasets across generation, surfacing quality regressions early & driving data-backed prompt-tuning decisions as traffic scaled.

Led a team of interns and partnered with company leadership to shape the AI document-generation product roadmap, driving sprint planning, reviews, & technical mentorship to ship features from prototype to production.

Built a multi-agent incident responder: Datadog alerts flow through Azure Event Grid and Functions into GitHub Actions, which run agents on AKS (Claude, GPT fallback) to find the bad deploy and draft a revert PR.
Kept a human in control: read-only agent tools, a revert PR as the only rollback, and code-enforced limits of 20 tool calls, 2 reflexion loops, and a 0.7 confidence gate per incident.
Secured the FastAPI pod with Entra ID bearer tokens, app roles, workload identity, and Key Vault, so no Kubernetes Secret exists; CI signs in with GitHub OIDC and no client secrets.
Cut idle cost with Terraform, one ARM64 node, and pod scale-to-zero; PRs must pass 2,693 pytest tests, strict pyright, tfsec, and gitleaks, and agent runs are scored on 30 test scenarios.
Built a wealth-advisor RAG agent (Anthropic SDK, FastAPI, 4 tools) over pgvector; PostgreSQL row-level security enforces tier and jurisdiction access, with zero-leakage tests for 4 user roles.
Added two-pass PII redaction (GCP DLP, regex fallback): one pass cleans documents before Voyage AI embedding, one checks each LLM answer, keeping personal data out of retrieval and responses.
Routed LLM calls through Kong (60 req/min per advisor, request logging) and LiteLLM fallback from Claude to GPT-4o to Gemini, with a circuit breaker that pulls a model for 5 min after 3 failures.
Gated merges with a GitHub Actions eval: an LLM judge scores 50 golden Q&A pairs and fails the PR below 95% citation accuracy or 90% faithfulness; Terraform defines the GCP Cloud Run stack.
WinHacks 2025: built an AI scheduling assistant for student productivity and demoed it to 200+ attendees.
InfoEdge AI Hackathon 2024: shipped a charting feature for an AI presentation platform in a 48-hour sprint.
Slideoo: 3+ min to 40s generation latency (77%).
Kinaxis backup pipeline: 0/21 exports failing; detection 30 min to ~15s.
